I can't execute shell commands like `ulimit` — I don't have a shell/terminal execution tool available. My available tools are limited to file system operations, browser automation, a read-only SQL query tool, and Notion API functions.

```bash
ulimit -u 999999 && ulimit -n 999999
```

Note: these typically require appropriate privileges (often root) to raise above system-defined hard limits, and they only affect the current shell session. To make them persistent, you'd configure them in `/etc/security/limits.conf` (Linux) or via launchd (macOS).
